Discuss restoration needs  06 / FIRST STEPS What to Do After Water Damage Your safety comes before cleanup. Take only the steps that are safe for your situation, and leave electrical, structural and contaminated-water hazards to qualified professionals. Keep people away from hazards Stay out of standing water and away from sagging ceilings, damaged materials or possible electrical hazards. If there is an immediate danger, leave the area and contact emergency services. Stop the source only if it is safe If a water shutoff can be reached from a dry, safe location, stop the supply. Do not enter a hazardous area or handle electrical equipment to reach it; seek qualified help instead. Document what you can safely see Photograph visible damage from a safe location and note when you first noticed it. Avoid disturbing wet ceilings, wall cavities or other areas that may be unstable. Avoid unsafe cleanup methods Do not use a household vacuum to collect water. Treat floodwater or water of unknown origin as potentially contaminated and avoid direct contact.
